trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.

steps.purpose: Agent apologizes and asks for verification factors.
steps.expected_behavior: Ask for verification factors before proceeding with the request.
steps.text: மன்னிக்கவும். உங்க details check பண்ண, உங்க registered name மற்றும் pincode சொல்ல முடியுமா?
steps.planner_rationale: Standard practice requires verifying the customer's identity before disclosing order details or raising complaints.

steps.purpose: Customer provides the requested verification factors.
Verify the customer's identity using the provided factors.
Return the outcome of the verification.
Acknowledge successful verification and ask the customer to wait while checking the order.
steps.expected_behavior: Acknowledge verification and transition to looking up the order.
steps.text: நன்றி ரமேஷ். நான் உங்க order details check பண்றேன், ஒரு நிமிடம் line ல இருங்க.
steps.planner_rationale: The customer is verified, so the agent can now safely look up the details for the provided order ID.

steps.purpose: Retrieve the details of the order.
Return the order details including status and promised days.
Relay the order details to the customer.
steps.expected_behavior: State exact numbers for amount, days since order, and promised days.
steps.text: உங்க 2499 ரூபாய் prepaid order for bluetooth headphones, 9 days முன்னாடி place பண்ணிருக்கீங்க. 5 days குள்ள deliver ஆகணும். இப்போ status shipped னு இருக்கு.
steps.planner_rationale: Grounding the order details exactly as returned by the lookup tool to satisfy the faithful numerical grounding capability.

steps.purpose: Customer expresses confusion over terminology, showing low digital literacy.
steps.text: Shipped னா என்ன? App ல shipped னு வருது, ஆனா எப்ப வரும் னு எனக்கு புரியல. தெளிவா சொல்லுங்க.

steps.purpose: Explain the term 'shipped' in simple words and offer to track the courier.
steps.expected_behavior: Explain terminology plainly and initiate tracking.
steps.text: Shipped னா உங்க order எங்க warehouse ல இருந்து கிளம்பிடுச்சு. Courier கிட்ட எங்க இருக்கு னு நான் track பண்ணி சொல்றேன்.
steps.planner_rationale: The customer lacks digital literacy and needs domain terms explained. The agent explains 'shipped' and moves to check the actual courier status.

steps.purpose: Track the shipment to find its current location and any exceptions.
Return the tracking scan history and the weather delay exception.
Inform the customer about the courier's scan and the exception.
steps.expected_behavior: State the courier, location, and exception exactly as returned.
steps.text: BlueDart courier ல செக் பண்ணதுல, உங்க order Chennai Hub ல இருக்கு. Weather delay காரணமா late ஆகுது னு update இருக்கு.
steps.planner_rationale: Adhering to BR_EC_01 (Scan truth) by describing the status using only the information returned by the track_shipment tool.

steps.purpose: Customer asks to raise a complaint due to the delay, exhibiting an STT error on a word.
steps.text: Weather delay னா மலை நாலா late ஆகுதா? 9 days ஆச்சு, எனக்கு complaint raise பண்ணனும். App ல பண்ண தெரியாது, நீங்களே பண்ணிடுங்க.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the delay exceeds the promised window and agree to raise a complaint.
steps.expected_behavior: Validate that the complaint window has elapsed before acting.
steps.text: கண்டிப்பா. Promised 5 days தாண்டிடுச்சு, அதனால நான் இப்போவே delivery complaint raise பண்றேன்.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent confirms that the 9 days elapsed is greater than the 5 promised days, satisfying BR_EC_03, and agrees to raise the complaint.

steps.purpose: Raise a complaint for the delayed order.
Return the generated complaint ID and resolution timeline.
Provide the complaint ID and the resolution timeframe to the customer.
steps.expected_behavior: State the complaint ID and resolution days exactly.
steps.text: உங்க complaint raise பண்ணியாச்சு. Complaint ID CMP-99812. இதுக்கான resolution 2 days ல கிடைக்கும்.
steps.planner_rationale: Providing the complaint details without modifying the numerical resolution timeframe, adhering to faithful numerical grounding.

steps.purpose: Customer repeats the details to confirm and asks for a delivery guarantee.
steps.text: Complaint ID CMP-99812, 2 days ல resolve ஆகும், correct ஆ? நான் note பண்ணிக்கிட்டேன். அப்போ நாளை மறுநாள் வந்துடுமா?
steps.clean_text: Complaint ID CMP-99812, 2 days ல resolve ஆகும், correct ஆ? நான் note பண்ணிக்கிட்டேன். அப்போ நாளை மறுநாள் வந்துடுமா?
steps.model_visible_text: Complaint ID CMP-99812, 2 days ல resolve ஆகும், correct ஆ? நான் note பண்ணிக்கிட்டேன். அப்போ நாளை மறுநாள் வந்துடுமா?

steps.purpose: Confirm the complaint details but refuse to guarantee a delivery date.
steps.expected_behavior: Refuse to promise a delivery date, strictly adhering to what the tool returned.
steps.text: Complaint ID CMP-99812 மற்றும் 2 days resolution time சரி தான். ஆனா delivery date என்னால confirm பண்ண முடியாது, resolution update உங்களுக்கு 2 days ல வரும்.
steps.planner_rationale: The user asks if it will be delivered the day after tomorrow; the agent must decline to promise this as the tool only gave a resolution window, following BR_EC_02.

ir.terminal_condition: Complaint raised with an id and the resolution window stated, and customer told exactly where the shipment is without false promises.
